judged_text: `update` and `destroy` feed `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` directly into `save_host`/`destroy` with no nil check, so any request for a nonexistent host id raises NoMethodError on nil (`nil.host =` in save_host, `nil.destroy` in destroy). PUT or DELETE /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with a stale id (the host was already deleted from another admin session or tab) returns a 500 instead of a 404, and because the client delete flow has no rejection handler the row silently stays in the table.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without handling `nil` (nonexistent id). `save_host` does `host.host = ...`, which will raise `NoMethodError` if `host` is nil, and `destroy` will likewise raise on `nil.destroy`, producing a 500 instead of a 404. On the client side, the component `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` with no `.catch(...)`, so a failed delete would not be surfaced and the row would remain.
